OnOff On command primary functionality with DUT as Server
OnOff Secondary functionality (Lighting feature) with DUT as Server
yamlTests.comment: Requires PICS OO.S.F00 (Lighting feature): device declares the OnTime/OffWaitTime attributes but does not implement the functional OffWaitTime countdown timer, so the test fails at the first timing assertion (expects OffWaitTime in [270,300], gets 0).

yamlTests.name: OnOff Startup functionality (Lighting feature) with DUT as Server
yamlTests.comment: Requires PICS OO.S.F00 (Lighting feature) and a real device reboot (Step 3b/3c, gated on PICS_SDK_CI_ONLY/PICS_SKIP_SAMPLE_APP) to observe StartUpOnOff behavior, which this containerized DUT cannot perform.

Thermostat attributes with server as DUT
Thermostat functionality with client as DUT
yamlTests.comment: Requires PICS TSTAT.C (DUT acting as a Thermostat client/controller). This plugin's thermostat is a server-only device, so this test's role doesn't apply.

phytonTests.name: OnOff Scenes Management Cluster Interaction with DUT as Server
phytonTests.comment: Endpoint 2 does expose the ScenesManagement cluster, but RecallScene does not apply the stored OnOff extension field set back to the OnOff attribute, so the test fails at the 'OnOff should be TRUE after RecallScene 0x02' assertion (step 5b).

phytonTests.name: Thermostat setpoint limit configuration with server as DUT
phytonTests.comment: Writing MinHeatSetpointLimit to a value that violates the AutoMode deadband against MinCoolSetpointLimit is accepted instead of rejected with ConstraintError. This is @matter/node's ThermostatServer (a matterbridge dependency, not this plugin or matterbridge itself) reconciling the write by auto-adjusting the coupled MinCoolSetpointLimit (CHIP Setpoints::Fix() semantics) instead of rejecting it, because this device's AbsMinCoolSetpointLimit leaves headroom for that adjustment. Not fixable from this repo.

phytonTests.name: Thermostat occupancy schedule/setback functionality with server as DUT
phytonTests.comment: Opens a commissioning window via OpenCommissioningWindow, which fails with AdministratorCommissioning.StatusCode.Busy (IM Error 0x602, cluster-specific 0x02) even right after a fresh container restart. Not specific to the Thermostat cluster or this plugin — the DUT's admin-commissioning window is reported busy from boot in this container image.

phytonTests.name: Thermostat presets functionality with server as DUT
phytonTests.comment: Requires PICS TSTAT.S.F08 (Presets) and TSTAT.S.F0a (ThermostatSuggestions), neither of which this thermostat (FeatureMap=35: Heating+Cooling+AutoMode only) implements.
